cases.title: all-time by XP, ties broken on profile id, ranks from 1
cases.notes: Profile ids follow first activity, not subject order: cy acts first so cy's profile is id 1 and wins the tie with ada. Catches a twin that breaks ties on the awardable id or on name.

cases.title: boards by achievement count and by prize count
opted-out profiles are excluded by default and included on request
for() ranks one awardable type; without it every type is ranked
a weekly board ranks on XP earned this week, not lifetime XP
cases.notes: THE period ruling (laravel-fun-lab 0.8.0). A veteran with 10,000 XP from September who earns 1 XP this week ranks below a newcomer who earned 50. Before 0.8.0 the veteran scored 10,000 here, because the board summed the lifetime total of every metric touched in the period.

cases.title: XP earned one second before Monday 00:00 is not this week's
cases.notes: 2026-11-16 is a Monday. Catches a Sunday-start week and an exclusive or off-by-one start.

cases.title: daily starts at today's midnight, monthly on the 1st
a metric board ranks on that metric; with a period, on that metric's XP earned in it
pages carry the total and ranks continue from the page offset
a period board with the event log off is refused; all-time still works

result.message: A period leaderboard is computed from the event log, which is off. Use an all-time board, or turn the event log on.

cases.notes: Refused rather than empty: the event log is the only record of when XP was earned, and an empty board reads exactly like a quiet week.

cases.title: a profile with no XP (only a grant) is on the all-time board, not on a period board
